notes: Workspace State Restoration: Open tabs, selected connections, and active editor contents are automatically saved and restored across sessions.
Visual ER Diagram Generator: Automatically generate zoomable and pannable Entity-Relationship Diagrams from the schema using Mermaid.js.
Scheduled Tasks UI: Visually configure queries to run on a Cron schedule, track execution history, and assign them to specific connections.
Data Import (CSV to SQL): Upload CSV files to automatically infer column types, generate CREATE TABLE statements, and load data directly into any database connection.
Live Metrics Dashboard: View single-value metrics at a glance using Saved Queries tagged with 'metric' directly on the main dashboard view.
Saved Queries Management: Full CRUD for queries with tags, instant search, and one-click editor loading.
Schema Diff Engine: Compare database schemas between two connections to identify missing tables, missing columns, and data type mismatches.
Strict Read-Only Mode: Server-level query enforcement blocking mutating SQL (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE) with transaction read-only protection.
One-Click DDL Generation: Generate CREATE TABLE DDL directly from Schema Explorer for any table.
Multi-Format Export: Export query results to CSV, JSON, Markdown tables, and SQL INSERT statements.
Interactive Column Sorting: Sort tabular query results ascending/descending with visual sort direction indicators.
Summary Statistics Footer: Automatic calculation of Sum (Σ), Average (μ), Min (↓), and Max (↑) on numeric result columns.
Workspace State & Scheduled Queries: Backend support for persistent workspace tabs and automated query scheduling with webhook dispatch.
Interactive Schema & Object Explorer in sidebar: tree view for tables, columns, data types, primary keys, and foreign keys.
One-click schema actions: quick SELECT top 100 rows and click-to-insert table/column names into the active editor.
Run Selected SQL snippet: execute only the highlighted query portion or full editor content if nothing is selected.
Query Cancellation: cancel long-running queries in real-time via the active execution token and Cancel Query button.
In-Grid Instant Search & Quick Filter: fast multi-column filtering of tabular query results with live row count.
Data Visualization & Chart Mode: interactive Bar, Line, Pie, and Doughnut charts with light/dark theme support and PNG export.
Connection Safe Mode & Read-Only Guard: prevent accidental DROP, TRUNCATE, or unconditional DELETE/UPDATE on production databases with an interactive confirmation guard.
Visual EXPLAIN execution plan: inspect query performance and execution paths with one-click Explain.
Query Results table alignment: tabular numeric alignment, centered booleans, and null badges.
Sticky table header with solid background preventing bleed-through when scrolling.
Sticky row index (#) column pinned to the left with independent horizontal and vertical scrolling.
